purpose: Falsify or retain a forecast-level ACF lag-pair objective after the existing representation-level AutoCon relation objective failed its exact Solar H336 null replication.
research_question: When the prediction-connected variable-axis Mamba and its AutoCon representation relation path are held fixed, does directly aligning forecasts from train-ACF-lag paired input windows improve validation MSE?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. Every job uses skip_test=true and no test metric may be generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass would support only this mechanism on Solar H336. It would not establish cross-dataset, cross-horizon, test-set, speed, or publication-level superiority.

phases.name: solar_h336_forecast_pair_off
phases.purpose: Exact control retaining the prediction-connected AutoCon representation and its relation objective, but without the new forecast-pair term.

phases.name: solar_h336_forecast_pair_on
phases.purpose: Exact treatment with the training-only signed ACF forecast-lag-pair consistency term at the pre-registered weight 0.01.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: forecast-pair term on versus exact term-off control
comparison_contract.telemetry_gate: The treatment must record positive forecast_lag_pair_loss, positive forecast_lag_pair_count, and positive forecast_lag_pair_active_anchor_fraction in every completed seed.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Exploratory validation-only mechanism screen; it cannot support a test, baseline-superiority, speed, or publication claim.

stopping_rules: Do not modify the pair weight, architecture, seeds, data split, or training budget after launch.
Advance only if the treatment has lower mean validation MSE, wins at least two of three exact seed pairs, and passes the telemetry gate.
Otherwise stop this mechanism and do not run post-hoc weight searches or test evaluation.
